scope: Portable CVS2 continuation and platform metadata paired with the real native candidate producer. This is not original Windows8004-byte story-slot import/export or a full41A620 physical reconstruction. Original game EXEs were not launched and original game directories were not written.

producer_contract.prepared_1B: Pc1Runtime.prepareSave notifies a deferred capture; MesVm boundary observer runs after instructionFinished/finally and before another fetch. The portable leaf resumes after the owned raw companion; the raw native candidate still retains the before-companion cursor.
producer_contract.current_persist: Only flag0 persist4(argument1) notifies a current producer. A detached fresh pair consumes completeSave and elapse0 so the loadable leaf contains no pending-save replay. The live request remains pending until platform write success.
producer_contract.native_event: Only successful flag0 captureNativeEvent triggers synchronous capture before enter(), with eventKind0/1/2 native voice-stop ordering retained. Flag1 and raw26 preserve an earlier independent candidate.
producer_contract.normal_loader: Clearing native flag for mode1/3 preserves existing candidate bytes and the portable sidecar. Metadata object rebinding is not a new producer.

session_contract.format: P1CS version1 envelope: active CVS2 leaf + optional independent candidate CVS2 leaf/provenance/opaque platform metadata + checksum. Candidate leaf never contains another session envelope.
session_contract.identity: Full typed candidate and masked raw native bytes form the provenance fingerprint. Only native404E70 metadata bytes ordinary902 and920..925 are excluded; source script/SHA/rawPC/portablePC and producer kind are checked.
session_contract.restore: Decode active and independent leaf into unpublished fresh VM/host pairs; validate both candidate identities and script execution contracts, then merge current persistent settings/account progress and publish. Corruption/source/provenance failure retains the prior published session.
session_contract.legacy: Pure CVS2 loads are accepted through the existing engine contract but have no sidecar. A protected candidate cannot be synthesized from the currently running VM.
session_contract.platform_metadata: Synchronous optional callback is sampled at producer and saved with its leaf. Metadata bytes are opaque, checksummed and limited to2MiB. Platform decoding/thumbnail/audio-cursor use is outside this core fixture scope.
session_contract.bounds: Each CVS2 leaf at most32MiB; envelope at most70MiB; one active plus one candidate leaf.

native_metadata_preparation: The SaveMetadata overload patches the live native candidate before platform I/O using existing prepareWrite. A detached leaf patches only ordinary9:2/20/21..25 and its native candidate; all other story/scene/audio state remains the producer state. year+0x30 is masked to a byte before Variables.write, retaining native wrap. No new callback or producer is created.

cases: Prepared candidate31/A/musicA survives live91/B/musicB and raw26 SAVE entry.
Active session and earlier candidate both survive an envelope roundtrip; original selected-slot request restores the story leaf.
Flag0 auto captures current and normalizes pending save only in its detached continuation.
All three input-event kinds retain their voice-stop order and store caller state before system entry.
Flag1 input event cannot replace earlier prepared leaf.
Normal-loader flag clearing preserves candidate sidecar.
Checksummed corruption, resealed invalid provenance and changed source SHA fail before publishing a new session pair.
Producer callback failure stops before next record; original live request is not consumed during slot preparation.
Existing CVS2 without sidecar cannot manufacture independent candidate.
Native metadata preparation retains story state, applies exact7 known ordinary bytes and does not recapture metadata.

boundaries: Core producer selection and continuation are implemented; platform write/read atomicity, metadata pictures/audio cursors and long actual route outcomes are validated separately by the platform phase.
Native Windows story-slot interoperability, complete41A620 reconstruction/fade and arbitrary physical media cursor equivalence are not established.
Direct toolbar quick-save has no newly mapped native candidate producer and should remain explicitly unavailable rather than using current/menu VM as a substitute.
source_hash_note: Working-copy byte identities and their CRLF-to-LF-only equivalents are recorded separately.
